title: FAA DRPDS architecture questions to synthetic diagnostic-core coverage

semantics.purpose: Records which architecture questions are represented, partially represented, or not represented by the current synthetic core fixture.

coverage_levels.partial: A synthetic mode exercises a related endpoint or simplified fault shape, but does not cover the full evidence requirements or distinguish all hypotheses in the architecture question.
coverage_levels.none: The synthetic fixture has no defensible analogue for this architecture question.

mappings.rationale: Two independent virtual source-evidence channels can be distinguished in the engine fixture; transformers, sensing fuses, independent physical confirmation, and source-versus-channel fault discrimination are not modeled.

A single virtual generator-bus evidence-channel pattern is exercised; individual generator readiness, output breakers, capacity, load shedding, and engine-running versus electrical-availability distinctions are not modeled.
Separate virtual section-evidence channels are exercised; selected source paths, incomers, tie logic, interlocks, breaker feedback, and actual SWGR topology are not modeled.
A single virtual transfer-evidence channel pattern is exercised; no transfer sequence, generator permissive logic, breaker command/position relationship, or event timing is modeled.
A single virtual essential-output loss is exercised; upstream feeder protection, MCC/control causes, and local-load causes are not distinguished.
UPS input, rectifier, inverter, bypass, battery/DC subsystem, and output-switchboard states are not modeled.
The synthetic fixture has no individual UPS 1, UPS 2/3 bypass-reserve role, bypass path, or bypass-state evidence.
The synthetic fixture has no UPS 2 input, conversion, DC/battery, output-switchboard, or assigned Critical Bus A path evidence.
The synthetic fixture has no UPS 3 input, conversion, DC/battery, output-switchboard, or assigned Critical Bus B path evidence.
Synthetic A/B endpoint path-loss patterns are exercised, but assigned UPS outputs, output breakers, sensing validity, and actual bus topology are not modeled.
No PDU input, protection, or documented outgoing-feeder boundary exists in the fixture.
The synthetic fixture has no individual PDU input, internal conversion/distribution, protective-device, or measurement-quality evidence.
The synthetic fixture has no individual PDU outgoing feeder, protective device, PDU-to-SATS assignment, or SATS input evidence.
The synthetic fixture has no individual PDU pair map, maintenance state, counterpart capacity/availability, or affected SATS input assignment.
The synthetic fixture has no individual SATS identity, dual input states, source A/B assignment, or PDU feeder-to-SATS mapping.
The synthetic fixture has no source-loss event history, SATS source selection, automatic transfer state, event timing, or output-continuity evidence.
Only a generic downstream output-loss pattern is exercised; dual inputs, source selection, transfer event, and transfer state are absent.
The fixture has no individual SATS output-to-CDP incomer assignment, CDP incomer state, or incoming-path measurement.
The fixture has no individual CDP branch, protective-device state, circuit identity, or assigned critical-load evidence.
No CDP incomer, outgoing protective device, circuit identity, or individual critical load is modeled.
The fixture has no telemetry freshness, I/O, PLC, communications, DC control-power, or independent cross-check fault modes.
The synthetic fixture has no AC/DC auxiliary-supply, 125 V DC bus, battery-subsystem, or control-function evidence. The virtual standby-transfer evidence-loss mode is not a control-power diagnosis.

The synthetic fixture contains no load-bank, test switchboard, source-selection, interlock, switching-feedback, or load-response evidence. Existing generator-bus and standby-transfer virtual channels are not load-bank test-path diagnoses.

constraints: A partial mapping is test-shape correspondence only; it is not evidence that the synthetic mode diagnoses the architecture question.
No architecture question is converted into a MeasurementRequest by this crosswalk.
Synthetic fixture points and values remain software-only and must not be mapped to physical FAA terminals or measurements.
Unmapped questions are explicit coverage gaps, not healthy states or negative diagnoses.
New source, generator-bus, SWGR-section, and standby-transfer modes are isolated virtual evidence-channel patterns; they do not encode source-to-section wiring or a transfer sequence.
The control-power prerequisite is architecture-level only; the synthetic fixture does not model AC/DC auxiliary power or battery behavior.
Load-bank test-path coverage is absent from the synthetic fixture; no load-bank operation or switching sequence is represented.
